extracted.intended_audience: journalists, media professionals, and the general public interested in Indiana University news
extracted.subtask_description: Institutional news landing page for Indiana University that aggregates campus stories, featured resources for media, topical expert lists, and subscription information for press and public audiences.

rubrics_metrics.name: For the media / media assistance
rubrics_metrics.description: Let us help you cover the news. Our media specialists can connect you with faculty experts as well as guide you to the latest IU news.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Links and actions: Media resources, Arrange an interview, request a photo, or find your way around campus. Media specialists can be contacted to facilitate coverage and connect reporters with appropriate campus contacts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Faculty experts directory
rubrics_metrics.description: Find a faculty expert on any IU campus.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Search the staff directory by topic area to locate subject-matter experts for interviews or commentary (examples given such as Ukraine experts and a featured expert profile).

rubrics_metrics.name: Arrange interviews, photos, and campus access
rubrics_metrics.description: Arrange an interview, request a photo, or find your way around campus.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the media resources and media specialists to coordinate logistics for coverage, including interview scheduling, photo requests, and campus access directions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Topical resources and expert availability
rubrics_metrics.description: Topical resource pages and story lists connect reporters with experts and curated content on specific subjects (e.g., 'Ukraine experts' available to discuss Russia’s war in Ukraine).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The site curates topical pages and featured experts to make it easier for media to find timely commentary and background material on major ongoing issues.

rubrics_metrics.name: Feature stories editorial scope
rubrics_metrics.description: Feature stories: These in-depth features highlight the special stories, unique culture, and rich history of Indiana University.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Feature content is presented as a separate editorial track from news updates; use 'Explore feature stories' to find longer-form institutional narratives suitable for deeper coverage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Subscription and privacy policy for news releases
rubrics_metrics.description: Stay in touch with the things you love about IU by subscribing to news releases. There is no cost and no advertising. Subscribers’ email addresses will remain confidential with IU.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Subscription is free, non-commercial, and email addresses are handled confidentially by the university; suitable for journalists and members of the public who want regular updates.
